purpose.zh: 练胸部，让手臂往身前合拢更有力
purpose.en: Build your chest and your strength for bringing the arm across your body.

text.zh: 肘微弯不动，手臂往身前合拢
text.en: Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across

text.zh: 弹力带固定在身后外侧，和胸口一样高。
text.en: Anchor the band behind you and out to the side, at chest height.

text.zh: 合拢后停住，再慢慢打开，手别到身体后面。
text.en: Hold, then open slowly without letting the arm go behind you.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘一弯一伸，变成了推
commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening the elbow so it turns into a push.
Twisting your body with the arm.

cautions.zh: 固定点不牢时先别开始
cautions.en: Do not start until the anchor is secure.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前侧疼时减小幅度或停下
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder hurts, make the move smaller or stop.

changes: 动画 8 s 只做 1 下、合拢后停约 4.6 s，每侧 12 次改为 8 次（一组约 1 分钟）
口令按相位缩短（合拢/打开各约 0.9 s）；注意事项拆成两句短句
flags: 每下停约 4.6 s，节奏偏慢；如想要常规夹胸节奏（2 下/8 s）需改动画
